page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head centred at the top with the page number at top right. A separator rule sits midway down the page, followed by an italic centred title and the text of the passage below. Signature mark centred at the foot.

main_text.p: Leo est quintum signum, sydus lucidum, viginti septem stellis illustratum.
Virgo sextum signum viginti sex stellis conformatum.
Libra septimum signum stellis octo exornatum.
Scorpius octavum signum stellis viginti una conformatum.
Sagittarius nonum signum stellis triginta una constans.
Capricornus est decimum signum octodecim stellis depictum.
Aquarius est undecimum signum stellis viginti duabus, hominis aquam ex amphora effundentis effigiem referentibus, constans.
Pisces signum duodecimum est triginta quatuor stellis, pisces conjunctos exprimentibus, exornatum.
Hactenus de stellis in zodiaco: sequuntur stellæ ultra citraq; zodiacum.
main_text.head: Quotuplices sunt stellæ ultra citraq; zodiacum.
main_text.p: Duplices: Aquilonares vel Meridionales. Aquilo-nares sunt, quæ septentrionalibus hominibus conspiciuntur.

Ejusmodi numerantur viginti una: ut Cynosura, Helice, Draco, Bootes, Corona Ariadnes, Hercules, Cepheus, Lyra, Gallina, Cassiopeja, Perseus, He-niochus, Serpens, Serpentarius, Sagitta, Aquila, Delphinus, Pegasus, Equiculus, Andromeda, Tri-angulus.
Cynosura sive ursa minor est signum septem stellis, suo complexu figuram plaustro similem depin-gentibus, constans.

page.notes: No marginal notes. Long s printed as s has been written as s throughout. The "fuo" in the last paragraph is read as "suo". The "Cafliopeja" of the print is read as "Cassiopeja" and "Hc-niochus" as "He-niochus". No doubtful readings otherwise. The signature "x 4" is centred at the foot.
